gen-dafont-blockletter-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans keeps its curves well back from the stem, giving a sharp, refined line of text that never feels crowded. Blockletter's tall belly sits above it, and the two differ mainly in lowercase height.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab arrives dignified, with a gaping c and rounded lowercase. Blockletter's unbroken pencil line makes a crisp, modern foil, and that single-weight stroke against the slab's softer, classic build is what holds the pair together.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, its tall middle band keeping ascenders and descenders shallow while the e opens generously. Fauna One brings a bookish warmth, and Blockletter's plain constant-width lines answer it with a precise, modern chill.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-glegoo: Refined and a bit editorial, Glegoo opens its curves wide. Blockletter does best as a pipe-cleaner display line with a squat brush-pen belly, while Glegoo does its best work as big-countered text in a tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hanuman: Blockletter draws its diagonals as thick as its horizontals, a precise, modern display face with a squat belly. And Hanuman follows in a traditional, refined voice, its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals making paragraphs feel unhurried.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noticia-text: Glass-smooth, constant strokes from top to baseline define Blockletter's tall-bellied display letters. Noticia Text answers in a literary, dignified voice, its curved letters entered through big visible openings, so its lowercase fills most of the height.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-piazzolla: Hollow, glass-tube lettering of constant thickness gives Blockletter its precise, modern look up top. And Piazzolla takes over with refined authority, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e pried wide open.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-pridi: Marker-traced and squat-bellied, Blockletter looks precise and modern. Pridi then settles in as a classic, refined serif, its near-capital-sized small letters and generous curve gaps making a long page feel easy to move through.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-scope-one: Traditional and refined, Scope One lets its counters spill out into the space around them. And Blockletter, with the same line width in curves and straights, feels precise and modern beside its stubby ascenders and big x-height.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, Suwannaphum sets the tone below. Its c bends open like a paperclip and its high x-height stands like squared woodblock type, so a longer passage moves briskly under Blockletter's wire-like monoline heading.
